summary: B11's board block on every world cell and B12's one 3D scene graph at three distances: world cells tinted by control with routes drawn by risk, forces and the party as miniatures on the tethers, and the room distance showing a cell's footprint, spawn sockets and exits.

coordination.notes: The board block is content-side only: no AuthoredCell field is added, because the B6/B7 equality test in godot-rust/tests/authored_world.rs builds the wire cell field by field rather than mirroring the whole record, and AuthoredCell does not deny unknown fields. godot_bridge.rs takes exactly one read-only hunk (a `forces` array on the state dictionary: id, faction, cell, next cell, progress -- names only, no strength, readiness or supply). game/scripts/world/expedition_* is P7's and is not touched; the 2D ExpeditionRouteBoard stays the owner of the 2D board this round and the 3D board replaces it by a later card, not by a fork. P2's camera director and clay material are not on origin yet, so this lane carries a local fixed-isometric BoardCamera with the named angles and a local marked StandardMaterial3D; both are marked in comments for P2 to absorb.
